app.title: FengSui · H168-383 5G RF & Network Console
app.subtitle: Self-Hosted 5G RF Telemetry & Network Management Platform for Huawei 5G CPE Ultra 6 (H168-383)

auth.csrf_rejected: CSRF security check failed; please refresh and retry
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts; please retry in {seconds}s
auth.session_note: Independent local session; touches CPE for ~26ms per poll and never blocks http://192.168.8.1

session.mode_yielding: Human administrator is using the CPE WebUI; monitoring is politely yielding
session.mode_resumed: CPE WebUI is free again; live telemetry automatically resumed
session.mode_circuit_tripped: Anti-brute-force circuit breaker tripped ({code}); auto-retries halted

traffic.billing_day: Resets on day {day} of each month

controls.unlock_all_applied: Cleared all band and cell locks; restored automatic full-band selection
controls.reboot_confirm_required: Safety guard: reboot requires explicit confirm: true
controls.reboot_triggered: Router reboot command dispatched; link will recover in ~45-90s
controls.wifi7_updated: Wi-Fi 7 MLO / Dual-Band Handover settings updated
controls.yielded_cannot_mutate: A human admin is currently logged into CPE WebUI (192.168.8.1); control mutation politely aborted
controls.peer_daemon_active: Another FengSui daemon ({address}) drives this CPE; this one is on standby and stays off the router
controls.device_read_only: Writes are locked: FengSui was verified on {verified} only, and this router ({model}) is another model, so FengSui only reads it. Writes FengSui can do here can be turned on one at a time as experimental writes under Settings → Device, which can also report how the router works
controls.device_not_identified: Writes are locked until FengSui knows the router's model, and this time it could not read it (device/information). Nothing was written
controls.wifi_filter_entries: Wi-Fi MAC filter list updated ({count} devices)
controls.auto_unlock_applied: The WAN did not come back: cleared every band and cell lock automatically
controls.auto_reconnect_applied: The WAN is down: redialled the cellular data connection automatically
controls.experimental_pending: (experimental write, the next polls check it)

sms.marked_read_summary: Marked {count} SMS as read on the CPE

alerts.wan_down: Cellular data connection down for over {seconds}s (status {status})
alerts.signal_degraded: {rat} signal degraded for {minutes} min: RSRP {rsrp} dBm / SINR {sinr} dB
alerts.signal_recovered: {rat} signal recovered: RSRP {rsrp} dBm / SINR {sinr} dB
alerts.ca_dropped: Carrier aggregation dropped from {from} to {to} component carrier(s)
alerts.sms_storage_full: SMS storage full ({used}/{max}); new messages cannot be received
alerts.data_threshold: Monthly data {used} reached {percent}% of the {limit} plan
alerts.lock_drift: The router no longer matches the applied lock: {issue}
alerts.lock_realigned: The router matches the applied lock again
alerts.duplicate_daemon_standby: Another FengSui daemon ({address}) drives the same CPE: this one is on standby (no CPE sessions, no Telegram) until it stops
alerts.duplicate_daemon_leader: Another FengSui daemon ({address}) drives the same CPE: it went on standby; stop one of them
alerts.duplicate_daemon_cleared: The other FengSui daemon stopped; this one drives the CPE again
alerts.data_quarantined: These encrypted data files could not be decrypted with the current DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY and were moved aside (not deleted): {files}. If CPE_PASSWORD just changed while DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY was unset, set DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY to the previous password, rename the files back and restart
alerts.storage_write_failed: Could not save {file} ({reason}): the change is only in memory and is lost on restart unless a save works again. Check the free space and permissions of the data volume (said once an hour per file and cause)
alerts.lock_rolled_back: The WAN was still down {minutes} min after the lock, so every band and cell lock was cleared automatically (LOCK_ROLLBACK_AFTER_MIN)
alerts.lock_rollback_failed: The WAN is still down after the lock, but the automatic unlock did not complete: {reason}. Clear the locks from the console on the LAN
alerts.wan_auto_reconnect: The WAN has been down for {minutes} min; redialled automatically ({count}/{max} in 24 h; FengSui never reboots the router on its own)
alerts.wan_reconnect_exhausted: The WAN is still down and the {max} automatic redials for the last 24 h are used up; FengSui never reboots the router on its own: check the SIM, the plan or the cell
alerts.self_heal_read_only_reconnect: The WAN has been down for {minutes} min. FengSui would redial it (WAN_AUTO_RECONNECT_AFTER_MIN), but this router ({model}) is a model it was not verified on and its experimental redial is not turned on under Settings → Device, so it writes nothing: redial or restart it on the router's own page
alerts.self_heal_read_only_rollback: The WAN is still down after the lock, but this router ({model}) is a model FengSui was not verified on and its experimental band lock is not turned on under Settings → Device, so FengSui does not clear the lock on its own (LOCK_ROLLBACK_AFTER_MIN): clear it on the router's own page
alerts.model_unverified: The router reports {model}, a model FengSui was not verified on (verified: {verified}): FengSui only reads it, so monitoring works where the router provides it and writes are locked by default. Settings → Device in the console shows what it supports, turns on experimental writes one at a time (read the risks first) and can open a compatibility report
alerts.firmware_unverified: The router reports {model} firmware {version}, but FengSui's protocol is verified on {verified} only: locks, access control and SMS writes may not work. With Telegram configured, the notification comes with a prompt to hand to a coding agent (such as Claude Code) to check the build
alerts.write_readback_mismatch: The experimental write {action} on {model} reads back differently: {reason}. The router may not have applied it; Settings → Device lists the recent write results for a compatibility report

readback.differs: the router reports another value than was written
readback.unreadable: the value to check could not be read
readback.send_failed: the router reports the send failed
readback.send_unconfirmed: the router never confirmed the send
readback.no_change: the SMS counts did not change
readback.unclear_change: the SMS counts changed by another amount
readback.no_restart: the next polls show no restart or new connection
readback.no_evidence: the next polls could not tell
